text:
rebecca: Quick sync - we keep hitting p99 regressions when compact-on-idle runs right as short inferences arrive. Idea: combine tenant "compaction lease" + pool-level fairness tokens and lightweight prefetch hints.

maria: Can you outline the lease semantics?

rebecca: Lease = short no-evict window per-request (default 80-150ms) + tenant compaction credit bucket. Evictor must check for active leases before moving pages that overlap recent request stamps. Credits meter background compaction over time.

lee: Two implementation constraints: 1) leases must be checkable with an atomic epoch compare (no locks on allocate hotpath); 2) compaction must be chunked and checkpointed so it can safely stop if credits exhausted or lease detected.

omar: For chunking, prefer 32KB-128KB chunks and a tiny per-slab progress record (journal) written atomically. On preempt, write a tombstone/resume marker. Resume logic must be idempotent.

rebecca: Also add pool tokens for fairness: each GPU pool has X tokens; tenant compaction runs consume tokens proportional to tenant weight. Noisy tenant can't starve pool. Pool tokens refill at a controlled rate.

maria: Telemetry we should capture: lease_acquired_count, lease_ms_avg, compaction_credit_ms_remaining_by_tenant, compaction_chunks_started/completed, compaction_preempt_reasons, pool_token_usage, small_request_p50_p95_p99_by_tenant.

lee: Prefetch nuance: add request hint prefetch_profile: "none|short|balanced|aggressive". Short => probabilistic prefix prefetch (top K spans), avoid full KV pulls. Also tag prefetches with request epoch so compactor can avoid evicting freshly-prefetched pages for lease duration.

omar: API sketches: 
- lease_token = allocator.request_lease(request_id, want_ms, tenant_id)
- bool lease_still_valid = lease_manager.check(lease_token)
- evictor.acquire_compact_token(tenant_id, want_ms, priority) -> compaction_token
- evictor.heartbeat(compaction_token) -> continue|stop
These are cheap string tokens or integers to avoid heavy structures on hot paths.

rebecca: Rollout plan: behind feature flag -> 1% canary (verbose metrics) -> 10% -> cohort autotune (adjust lease ms and credit refill) -> full. Include kill-switch to disable leases and revert compactor to legacy behavior.

maria: Autotune logic idea: if small_request_p99 rises above SLO, increase lease default or slow credit refill for affected tenants; if fragmentation growth exceeds threshold, tighten credits. Keep a hysteresis window to avoid flip-flopping.

omar: Correctness checklist: compaction idempotency verified by journal + versioned slab headers; unit tests simulate mid-chunk aborts and random restarts; e2e perf test with bursty workloads.

lee: I'll prototype lease manager + compaction token and a small in-memory simulator to validate pool token fairness. Will post PR and perf numbers.

rebecca: I'll draft short RFC with API, metrics, failure modes, and test plan. Tagging @maria @lee @omar.
